text: ロケットだんを　うらぎって　ただで　すむと　おもうな！

structure.jp: ロケットだんを　うらぎって

patterns.name: 〜な (prohibition)
patterns.explanation: な right after the plain form of a verb is a blunt order not to do it. おもうな = 'don't think'.

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: と before おもう wraps up the thought itself, like 'that'. ただで　すむと　おもうな = 'don't think that you'll get off free'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to what follows, like 'and'. うらぎって　ただで　すむ = 'betray us and get off free'.
